in_hebrew.name: לורדס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew words לור (lur) which means 'mount' and דס (des) which means 'gods'. It is often translated as 'Mount of the Gods'.

in_greek.name: Λουρδές
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Lurdes has no direct meaning in Greek, but it is the transliteration of the Spanish name Lourdes, which in turn comes from the Latin name Lourdia.

in_latin.name: Lourdia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Lourdes in Latin is believed to derive from the word 'lourdus', which means 'heavy, weighty, or burdensome'. This name may have been given due to the town's reputation as a place of pilgrimage and healing, as pilgrims would carry heavy burdens in their journey to Lourdes.
